verdict.rationale: Mirrors has its own capture hooks that upload execution snapshots and record how each execution ended. It also stores traces and lets you review agent sessions, so multi-step runs are recorded and grouped by session in some form. However, it positions itself as distinct from observability tools like Langfuse and LangSmith, and nothing shows nested span hierarchies or thread grouping. Missing for 10: nested span structure, thread grouping, a trace-viewer UI, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Capture uploads a full snapshot in the background.
A final capture records how the execution ended.
Review your agent’s sessions alongside your outcome labels and feedback.
Preview your routing conditions against stored traces to review matches, misses, and unexpected matches before activation.
